verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm, so trade-secret practice is a fair axis. The pack documents patents, trademark/copyright, IP diligence and general employment litigation, but nothing on trade secrets, confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes or trade-secret litigation. Adjacent IP and employment practices and the generic 'protect what differentiates your company' line do not count for this story.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation
